# Course Teaching

<h2 class="expandable-title" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-ec210')">EC210 – Inequality and Poverty Analysis</h2>

Seminar teacher<br>Summer Term 2023-2024; 2024-2025; 2025-2026<br>Class teacher: Stephen Jenkins and Berkay Ozcan<br>[LSE course page](https://www.lse.ac.uk/study-at-lse/summer-schools/summer-school/courses/economics/ec210)

<p id="desc-ec210" class="abstract-teaser" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-ec210')">An introduction to measuring and analysing inequality and poverty from a quantitative perspective, covering monetary and multidimensional approaches and drawing on national and global evidence.</p>

<h2 class="expandable-title" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-my457')">MY457 – Causal Inference</h2>

Problem sets and office hours<br>Winter Term 2023-2024; 2024-2025<br>Class teacher: Daniel de Kadt<br>[LSE course page](https://www.lse.ac.uk/resources/calendar2025-2026/courseGuides/MY/2025_MY457.htm)

<p id="desc-my457" class="abstract-teaser" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-my457')">An advanced introduction to causal inference in the social sciences, covering experimental and observational designs including matching, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, and difference-in-differences.</p>

# Teaching Materials

<h2 class="expandable-title" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-Measuring.Inequality.of.Opportunity')">Measuring Inequality of Opportunity</h2>

<p id="desc-Measuring.Inequality.of.Opportunity" class="abstract-teaser" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-Measuring.Inequality.of.Opportunity')">An introduction to measuring inequality of opportunity using Roemer's framework, covering ex-ante and ex-post approaches and comparing cells-based, parametric, and data-driven estimation methods, with a hands-on implementation in R.</p>
